university.name: City St George's, University of London
university.summary: City St George's, University of London teaches from campuses at Clerkenwell and Tooting. Its Bayes Business School and its schools of science, technology and health offer undergraduate and postgraduate taught courses, and it publishes a funding search that includes international awards.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor (gov.uk register of student sponsors, file dated 2026-10-07, Student route)

courses.title: Finance MSc
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's at Bayes Business School. Term 1 is compulsory and covers investments, corporate finance and valuation, data analytics for finance and financial reporting. Term 2 has one compulsory module and electives, and term 3 offers electives or a research project.
highlights: Data Analytics with AI for Finance
courses.academic_requirements: A UK upper second-class degree or above, or an equivalent overseas qualification. Applicants are ideally recent graduates in finance, economics or a related field with adequate numerical ability; GMAT is not required but may be requested.
courses.english_requirements: Bayes master's page: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no section below 6.0 (IELTS General not accepted); PTE Academic 62 with no section below 60 (in-person test only); TOEFL iBT 90 overall with Listening 19, Speaking 22, Reading 20, Writing 19.
courses.notes: Course page shows September 2026 start and the September 2026 fee of GBP 35,700 (international); target year fee not yet published, and no 2027 intake is visible. English scores come from https://www.bayes.citystgeorges.ac.uk/study/masters/apply/entry-requirements, which applies the same thresholds to all Bayes MSc programmes; the course page itself states none. No Pakistan-specific threshold was found.

courses.title: Business Analytics MSc
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's at Bayes Business School in analytics for business. Compulsory terms 1 and 2 cover analytics fundamentals, data management, statistics, machine learning and optimisation, followed by an industry project and three electives.
highlights: Machine Learning for Business Applications I
courses.academic_requirements: A UK upper second-class degree (2:1) or above, or the equivalent from an overseas institution. Work experience is not required. A degree with some quantitative content is preferred, and other graduates may be considered if they show numerical ability.
courses.english_requirements: Bayes master's page: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no section below 6.0 (IELTS General not accepted); PTE Academic 62 with no section below 60 (in-person test only); TOEFL iBT 90 overall with Listening 19, Speaking 22, Reading 20, Writing 19.
courses.notes: Course page shows September 2026 start and the September 2026 international fee of GBP 31,000; target year fee not yet published, and no 2027 intake is visible. English scores come from the Bayes master's entry requirements page, not the course page. Modules listed are compulsory term 1 and 2 modules. No Pakistan-specific threshold was found.

courses.title: Management MSc
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's at Bayes Business School for graduates from any discipline. Compulsory modules cover management analytics, strategy, organisational change and financial reporting, with specialist electives and a research project.
courses.academic_requirements: A UK upper second class degree or above, or the equivalent from an overseas institution. Previous study of business, management or finance is not required, and work experience is not a requirement.
courses.english_requirements: Bayes master's page: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no section below 6.0 (IELTS General not accepted); PTE Academic 62 with no section below 60 (in-person test only); TOEFL iBT 90 overall with Listening 19, Speaking 22, Reading 20, Writing 19.
courses.notes: Course page shows September 2026 start and the September 2026 international fee of GBP 33,600; target year fee not yet published, and no 2027 intake is visible. English scores come from the Bayes master's entry requirements page, not the course page. Modules listed are the term 1 compulsory modules. No Pakistan-specific threshold was found.

scholarships.name: MSc Dean's Scholarships
scholarships.provider_name: Bayes Business School, City St George's, University of London
scholarships.value_text: Up to 20% of tuition, deducted from the January instalment
scholarships.summary: A fee reduction for full-time Bayes MSc applicants based on academic achievement and the course application. Applicants are considered automatically and are told in the offer letter. Awards are made while funds last.
scholarships.criteria_text: All full-time Bayes MSc applicants, considered on academic achievement and course application. The page does not restrict by nationality.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated; awarded while funds last.
scholarships.intake_label: Entry year not stated on the page
scholarships.notes: The scholarships page mostly shows 2026 deadlines, so 2027 terms may differ. The page does not explicitly say international students are eligible, only that there is no geographic restriction.

scholarships.name: Graduate Loyalty Discount
scholarships.provider_name: City St George's, University of London
scholarships.summary: An alumni discount on Bayes MSc fees for City St George's graduates. It cannot be combined with a Bayes scholarship. How to apply and any deadline are not stated on the page.
scholarships.criteria_text: City St George's graduates only; cannot be combined with a Bayes scholarship.
scholarships.intake_label: Entry year not stated on the page
scholarships.notes: The application route is not stated; automatic is assumed and should be confirmed. The page links to https://www.city.ac.uk/alumni/benefits for terms, which was not opened.

scholarships.name: Bayes Business School International Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.provider_name: Bayes Business School, City St George's, University of London
scholarships.value_text: GBP 8,000 reduction in first-year tuition fees, deducted from the second fee instalment
scholarships.summary: A first-year fee reduction for international fee-paying students who hold an offer for a full-time Bayes undergraduate programme and choose City St George's as their firm UCAS choice. Applicants register interest by email instructions. Published terms cover September 2026 entry.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee payer with an offer for first-year entry to a full-time Bayes undergraduate programme, firm UCAS choice, academic conditions met, sufficient funds shown, not on an international foundation year, registered interest by the deadline.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026 round: apply via UCAS and register interest by 30 June 2026. 2027 dates not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Award is non-transferable and non-deferrable. Excludes the International Study Centre and Kaplan foundation routes and Clearing. The 2026 round has closed.

scholarships.name: President's International Scholarship
scholarships.provider_name: City St George's, University of London
scholarships.value_text: 50% of the first-year course fee, applied as a fee discount (up to 30 awards for 2026 entry)
scholarships.summary: A first-year fee discount for self-funded overseas fee-paying undergraduates starting at the Clerkenwell campus. Eligible UCAS applicants are invited to apply by email and are assessed on academic potential and a short personal statement. Published terms cover 2026 entry.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee payer, self-funded, new Year 1 student at Clerkenwell, full-time, City St George's as firm UCAS choice, not progressing from a foundation year, not holding other City St George's scholarships.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026 round: application by 4 June 2026 via an emailed invitation link. 2027 dates not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Page is inconsistent on timing of the discount (start of second term versus second instalment). Tooting campus courses are excluded.
